name: @desklink/agent
description: DeskLink host — captura de tela e controle local
author: DeskLink

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/copy-html.mjs
scripts.build:host-bundle: npm run build && npm run build-icon && electron-builder --win dir --x64 && node scripts/patch-host-icon.mjs
scripts.pack:agent: npm run build:host-bundle && npm run prepare:wizard-payload
scripts.pack:wizard: npm run build:host-bundle && npm run prepare:wizard-payload && npm run build:deploy-wizard
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build-icon && electron-builder --win portable --x64
